mxCell.value: CDC FIFO — RTL ALIGNED MICROARCHITECHTURE
Exact RTL signal names • DATA_WIDTH=32 • ADDR_WIDTH=4 • DEPTH=16 • PTR_W=5

TOP-LEVEL RESET
arst_n (active-low async assertion)

u_wr_reset_sync : reset_sync
clk = wr_clk
arst_n = arst_n
srst_n = wr_rst_n
STAGES = RESET_SYNC_STAGES

u_rd_reset_sync : reset_sync
clk = rd_clk
arst_n = arst_n
srst_n = rd_rst_n
STAGES = RESET_SYNC_STAGES

WRITE CONTROL (wr_clk)
Inputs: wr_en, full
wr_fire = wr_en && !full
overflow <= wr_en && full
Accepted write advances pointer

WRITE POINTER + GRAY
wbin, wgray [PTR_W-1:0]
wbin_next = wbin + wr_fire
wgray_next = bin_to_gray(wbin_next)
wr_clk: wbin <= wbin_next
wr_clk: wgray <= wgray_next

FULL DETECTION (wr_clk)
full_next = (wgray_next ==
{~rgray_sync2[PTR_W-1:PTR_W-2],
rgray_sync2[PTR_W-3:0]})
full <= full_next

WRITE OUTPUTS
full • overflow

ONE SHARED BEHAVIORAL ARRAY
mem[0:DEPTH-1]
Default: 16 words × 32 bits

WRITE PORT (wr_clk):
if (wr_fire) mem[wbin[ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]] <= wr_data

READ PORT (rd_clk):
if (rd_fire) rd_data <= mem[rbin[ADDR_WIDTH-1:0]]
rd_valid <= rd_fire

RTL array placeholder — not an instantiated SRAM macro

READ POINTER + GRAY
rbin, rgray [PTR_W-1:0]
rbin_next = rbin + rd_fire
rgray_next = bin_to_gray(rbin_next)
rd_clk: rbin <= rbin_next
rd_clk: rgray <= rgray_next

READ CONTROL (rd_clk)
Inputs: rd_en, empty
rd_fire = rd_en && !empty
underflow <= rd_en && empty
Accepted read advances pointer

EMPTY DETECTION (rd_clk)
empty_next = (rgray_next == wgray_sync2)
empty <= empty_next
Reset value: empty = 1

READ OUTPUTS
rd_data[DATA_WIDTH-1:0]
rd_valid • empty • underflow

READ POINTER → WRITE DOMAIN
rgray → rgray_sync1 → rgray_sync2
Both stages clocked by wr_clk
Async reset: wr_rst_n
Used by full comparison

WRITE POINTER → READ DOMAIN
wgray → wgray_sync1 → wgray_sync2
Both stages clocked by rd_clk
Async reset: rd_rst_n
Used by empty comparison

Parameters: DATA_WIDTH=32, ADDR_WIDTH=4, RESET_SYNC_STAGES=2
